title: Steak Tips in the Oven
description: Simple beef steak tips in the oven are a meal for any time of the year, and a long soak in a sweet and tangy marinade makes these extra special!
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 cup beef broth, or as needed

steps.text: Whisk soy sauce, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, mustard, maple syrup, molasses, sesame oil, cinnamon, cloves, salt, and pepper together in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Add steak tips and toss to evenly coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for 6 to 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Remove steak tips from the marinade and shake off excess. Discard the remaining marinade. Put steak tips into a baking dish and fill the bottom of the dish with beef broth.

Bake in the preheated oven until steak tips are hot, slightly pink in the center, and beginning to firm, about 25 minutes, flipping halfway. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees F (60 degrees C) for medium doneness.
